findings.message: Helm will delete objects the new chart does not render: Secret/default/aws-load-balancer-webhook-secret.

The CRD targetgroupbindings.elbv2.k8s.aws under crds/ changed (the file contents changed). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
ClusterRole/default/stageproof-rel-aws-load-balancer-controller-role adds rules that the current chart did not have.
Role/default/stageproof-rel-aws-load-balancer-controller-leader-election-role adds rules that the current chart did not have.
Chart default `image.pullPolicy` changed from `Always` to `IfNotPresent` and the rendered objects differ.

Chart default `image.repository` changed from `amazon/aws-alb-ingress-controller` to `602401143452.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/amazon/aws-load-balancer-controller` and the rendered objects differ.
Chart default `image.tag` changed from `v2.0.0-rc2` to `v2.0.0` and the rendered objects differ.

The pod template of Deployment/default/stageproof-rel-aws-load-balancer-controller changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=aws-load-balancer-controller].args. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.
